ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of DBGHELP.DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "dbghelp.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SoftwareDistribution\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SystemTemp\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\"))) AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\Anaconda3\\\\Lib\\\\site\\-packages\\\\vtrace\\\\platforms\\\\windll\\\\amd64\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\Anaconda3\\\\Lib\\\\site\\-packages\\\\vtrace\\\\platforms\\\\windll\\\\i386\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll$")) OR (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\Epic\\ Games\\\\Launcher\\\\Engine\\\\Binaries\\\\ThirdParty\\\\DbgHelp\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\Epic\\ Games\\\\MagicLegends\\\\x86\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll$")))
